claims.anchor: Where does the money come from? Assume a l
claims.claim: Assumed 50% debt financing requires ~$5.85m debt and ~$5.85m equity per property before transaction costs
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: So what could an operator do to actually c
claims.claim: $50k annual incremental site NOI yields ~$769,230 additional value at unchanged 6.5% cap, before costs
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: Now there are two different growth engines
claims.claim: Buy/build/manage routes differ in ownership, financing and operational risks
claims.basis: Inference from financial and operating structure; qualified in research.md.

claims.anchor: Look at how big those choices can become.
claims.claim: Public Storage acquired 87 sites for $945.6m in 2025; Extra Space managed 1,856 third-party sites at 2025 year-end
claims.basis: Opened 2025 original operator report at source locator.

claims.anchor: Now assume we somehow assemble one hundred
claims.claim: 2025 industry management acknowledges supply and move-in price pressure; 180 identical sites are a scenario only
claims.basis: Inference from financial and operating structure; qualified in research.md.

claims.anchor: Still, look at the math. One hundred and e
claims.claim: 180 modeled properties gross $2.106bn and financed with $1.053bn debt leave $1.053bn property equity
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: Here's the uncomfortable part. To buy thos
claims.claim: At assumed fair value, building portfolio at that scale requires about $1.053bn cash equity and same debt, not instant incremental investor wealth
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: Remember that extra fifty thousand dollars
claims.claim: $50k NOI uplift ×180 = $9m extra annual property NOI, implies ~$138.46m gross value at 6.5% assumed cap before improvement costs
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: Even a huge portfolio isn't an unlimited c
claims.claim: $136.89m modeled portfolio annual NOI, $63.18m interest at 6%, $10m G&A+$15m capex reserve leave $48.71m before further costs
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: Now test a bad year. Revenue per available
claims.claim: Adverse scenario annual revenue/SF down 10%, property NOI margin 60%, cap rate 7.5%
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: Together those changes push modeled proper
claims.claim: Scenario downside property $1.51632bn with fixed $1.053bn debt leaves $463.32m equity, 56.0% decline
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: There's one more catch. Suppose you founde
claims.claim: Founder 20% stake is not automatic from operation; requires equity contribution or contractual incentive terms
claims.basis: Inference from financial and operating structure; qualified in research.md.

claims.anchor: If you did keep twenty percent of the bill
claims.claim: 20% of ~$1.053bn property equity is ~$210.6m, stated ~$200m on rounded $1bn; subject to investor preference/tax/liquidity
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.

claims.anchor: So what does it take? A facility that earn
claims.claim: Scale threshold and value creation require funding/access/operations and genuinely negotiated claim rights
claims.basis: Explicit assumption or formula in the reproducible research model.
